subject: Out of Memory while extracting large STAN fit object

messages.author: a997b66afa263bd1
messages.subject: Out of Memory while extracting large STAN fit object
parts:
I am running STAN on R, and my stanfit object is pretty large (7GB). I want to use extract() to extract the parameters, but am getting an out of memory error. I am running a 14GB /x64 machine .

> object.size(stan_fit_4)
7530465376 bytes
> memory.limit()
[1] 14335


How do I get around this issue?

Thanks and Regards

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Out of Memory while extracting large STAN fit object
parts:
Hi, did you try to extract() all the parameters at once?  It should use less memory if you just extract the parameters you need.  Also, people sometimes run their chains longer than they need.  For most purposes you won’t need 10,000 draws or whatever.
A
